name: session-flow
description: Session lifecycle: workflow (next stage), handoff (save-point, resume prompt), continue-in-background, keep-going (resume after a stall), find-handoff, clean-stop, retro and running-retro, audit-sessions, audit-friction, orient (where the session stands), orchestrate, reanchor (verify assumptions), reconcile (retire finished work), recommend-skills, tidy-work (.work tiers), step-away (run unattended, report on return), go-with-recommendations (accept after an evidence check), check, setup.

observer_enabled.title: Session observer
observer_enabled.description: Watches interactive sessions for process mistakes: live checks write findings to the running-retro ledger and show them above the prompt, and each session start analyzes ended sessions that got none. Off by default. See reference/observer.md.

observer_step_check.title: Observer step checks
observer_step_check.description: While the observer is on, runs a live check every observer_step_every model steps of a long turn: a no-tools fork of the main conversation that reports at most one process fault. On by default. Each check bills the session's account; its usage is recorded.

observer_turn_end_check.title: Observer live check at turn end
observer_turn_end_check.description: While the observer is on, also runs a live check at the end of each turn that ran tools, which is most turns of a working session. Off by default until its cost on a working session is measured; see reference/observer.md.

observer_step_every.title: Observer steps between step checks
observer_step_every.description: Model steps between live step checks; default 6.

observer_auto_send.title: Observer auto-send
observer_auto_send.description: Deliver live-check findings to the agent without pressing Send: mid-turn as a reminder on its next request, while idle as one observer turn. Idle delivery needs the turn-end check on. Off by default; see reference/observer.md.

observer_auto_note.title: Observer auto-send note
observer_auto_note.description: Text that leads an auto-sent finding or a gate refusal, framed as the plugin, never the person.
observer_auto_note.default: The session-flow observer, a side reviewer beside this session, flagged this. It is not the person's instruction. If it holds, stop and fix it before your next action, and say so in one line; if not, say why in one line and continue.

observer_guidance.title: Observer guidance
observer_guidance.description: Your own guidance, added to every live check: what to pay attention to. It steers the checks, not what is sent. Empty by default.

observer_check_prompt.title: Observer check instructions
observer_check_prompt.description: Replaces the built-in live-check instructions; the already-reported lists and the answer shape stay. Empty uses the built-in text.

observer_change_check.title: Observer check after edits
observer_change_check.description: Run a live check at the step after one that called a tool in observer_change_tools. Off by default.

observer_change_tools.title: Observer change tools
observer_change_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names that count as a change for the edit check.

observer_gate_check.title: Observer command gate
observer_gate_check.description: Hold Bash commands matching observer_gate_pattern until a live check returns; a finding refuses the command with the observer note. A timeout or observer error lets it run. Off by default.

observer_gate_pattern.title: Observer gate pattern
observer_gate_pattern.description: Regular expression for commands the gate holds: by default git push, gh pr create/merge/comment/review, gh issue create/comment, and gh api with a writing method.

observer_gate_timeout_seconds.title: Observer gate timeout (seconds)
observer_gate_timeout_seconds.description: Longest the gate holds a command; the command then runs. Default 30.

observer_gate_refusals.title: Observer gate refusals per command
observer_gate_refusals.description: Times the gate refuses the same command before letting it run; default 1.

observer_clear_after_prompts.title: Observer finding lifetime (prompts)
observer_clear_after_prompts.description: Prompts a shown finding survives unanswered before it clears; default 2.

observer_ignored_free.title: Observer ignored findings before backoff
observer_ignored_free.description: Ignored findings in a row before later checks are skipped; default 2.

observer_skip_max.title: Observer backoff cap
observer_skip_max.description: Most live checks the backoff skips in a row; default 16.

observer_analysis_enabled.title: Observer catch-up analysis
observer_analysis_enabled.description: At session start, runs the headless running-retro analysis for ended sessions that got no live checks and writes its findings to their ledger. On by default. Off, no catch-up runs; the live checks are unaffected.

observer_analysis_model.title: Observer analysis model
observer_analysis_model.description: Model ID for the headless catch-up analysis run, the dominant cost lever. The default was chosen for faithful findings: in a local pilot it missed and invented the fewest; pin a different ID to trade depth for cost.

observer_analysis_effort.title: Observer analysis effort
observer_analysis_effort.description: Effort level passed as --effort to the headless catch-up analysis run, a second cost lever beside the model. The level is passed explicitly and also pins CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, which would override it. Accepted levels depend on the model. See reference/observer.md.

observer_analysis_bare.title: Bare mode for the analysis run
observer_analysis_bare.description: Passes --bare to the analysis run, dropping auto-discovery as a further cost lever. Off by default because --bare fails on OAuth-login installs (the run reports Not logged in); turn it on only where auth is an env-var API key. See reference/observer.md.

observer_min_lines.title: Observer minimum session size (lines)
observer_min_lines.description: Transcript lines an ended session needs before its first catch-up analysis; default 300. A shorter session, such as an automated sweep, is skipped and the skip recorded in the observer's status file. A follow-up to an analyzed session is always analyzed. 0 analyzes every session.

observer_idle_seconds.title: Observer ended-session threshold (seconds)
observer_idle_seconds.description: How long a transcript must go unchanged before the catch-up treats its session as ended; default 900. Keep it above the longest single turn, or a session still mid-turn in another terminal is analyzed early.

audit_sessions_retention_days.title: Session store retention (days)
audit_sessions_retention_days.description: How long audit-sessions keeps a session's record in its local store after the session ended; default 180. 0 keeps every record. Collect drops older records and never ingests a session already past the window.

audit_sessions_excerpt_chars.title: Turn excerpt length (characters)
audit_sessions_excerpt_chars.description: Longest redacted excerpt of a short typed turn that audit-sessions stores; default 240, maximum 600. 0 stores no excerpt text at all. Redaction always runs first and cannot be turned off.

audit_sessions_excerpt_words.title: Short turn limit (words)
audit_sessions_excerpt_words.description: A typed turn of this many words or fewer, right after a Claude reply, is flagged and excerpted by audit-sessions; default 60. These are the turns most likely to be corrections.

audit_sessions_drift_min_count.title: Drift key minimum count
audit_sessions_drift_min_count.description: How often a transcript key must appear in a Claude Code version before audit-sessions' drift check reports it as new or vanished; default 20. Raise it if rare keys clutter the drift section.

audit_sessions_drift_versions.title: Drift vanish window (versions)
audit_sessions_drift_versions.description: How many of the newest Claude Code versions a key must be absent from before audit-sessions' drift check reports it vanished; default 3, maximum 20.

worker_continuation.title: Worker continuation
worker_continuation.description: How /session-flow:orchestrate runs a worker's next unit: resume (default) continues the same worker; respawn starts a fresh worker with consolidated scope unless that worker holds state costly to move. A repository's worker_continuation in docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

wip_commit.title: WIP commit on pause
wip_commit.description: When you ask to pause, /session-flow:handoff makes one local chore(wip): commit of the tracked work. Off by default. Never pushed or run with hooks skipped; refused on the default branch, a detached HEAD, mid-merge or rebase, or a partial staging. docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

transcript_scope.title: Transcript scope
transcript_scope.description: How far /session-flow:find-handoff and /session-flow:recall read transcripts: worktree widens to the repo's other worktrees, then asks before other projects; repo starts with every worktree; all reaches every project unasked. The narrower of this and docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

recall_report_kinds.title: Recall incident and report kinds
recall_report_kinds.description: Comma-separated issue types or labels /session-flow:recall counts as an incident or a user report when it lists what is still reported; default Bug, which also matches a type: bug label. docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

recall_doc_paths.title: Recall postmortem paths
recall_doc_paths.description: Comma-separated git pathspecs /session-flow:recall searches for postmortems on the topic; default *.md, every tracked markdown file. docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

retro_lenses.title: Retro review lenses
retro_lenses.description: How many review passes /session-flow:retro session mode runs: 1 (default) one pass; 3 three parallel subagents (the calls made and why, the tools and steps used, the approaches not tried), merged before scoring. docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml wins.

lane_transcript_sink.title: Lane transcript sink
lane_transcript_sink.description: The private directory holding pulled CI lane transcripts and their metrics.jsonl, read by /session-flow:retro ci-runs and /session-flow:audit-sessions pr. Unset: ci-runs needs --sink and audit-sessions pr skips CI legs; there is no default location. A --sink given on the command line wins.

cloud_route.title: Cloud session suggestion
cloud_route.description: Whether /session-flow:workflow's end-of-phase continuation advice offers a cloud session when the next chunk of work fits one. offer (default) names it with the reason; off never mentions it. Advice only: nothing launches a cloud session unless you ask.

retro_offer.title: Retro offer
retro_offer.description: Whether /session-flow:workflow's end-of-session wrap-up offers a retrospective. offer (default) suggests /session-flow:retro for substantive sessions; off never offers one. Offer only: nothing runs a retro unless you ask.

recommend_skills_exclude.title: Recommend-skills exclusions
recommend_skills_exclude.description: Which skill states /session-flow:recommend-skills leaves out of its menu: none (default) names every skill, annotating disabled and not-installed ones; the others drop disabled skills, skills not installed, or both. The menu says which states it dropped.

orient_catch_up_word_cap.title: Orient catch-up word cap
orient_catch_up_word_cap.description: Most words /session-flow:orient catch-up may use for what happened, visuals excluded; default 250, minimum 150. Every action item is listed in full whatever the cap. The reply opens with what needs you, then what happened, then each decision.

away_night_start.title: Away night start
away_night_start.description: Local time of day, HH:MM, when /session-flow:step-away bed treats the night as starting; default 21:00. The night window runs from this time to the next report-by time. A time named in the launch words wins.

away_report_by_workday.title: Away report-by time, workdays
away_report_by_workday.description: Local time of day, HH:MM, by which /session-flow:step-away has its return report ready on a workday; default 09:00. A time named in the launch words wins.

away_report_by_day_off.title: Away report-by time, days off
away_report_by_day_off.description: Local time of day, HH:MM, by which /session-flow:step-away has its return report ready on a day off; default 10:00. A time named in the launch words wins.

away_days_off.title: Days off
away_days_off.description: Comma-separated three-letter weekday names /session-flow:step-away treats as days off when it picks the report-by time; default Sat,Sun.

away_watched_folders.title: Away watched folders
away_watched_folders.description: Comma-separated folders /session-flow:step-away scans for files written while you are away; empty (default) scans the home folder. Dot folders and git work trees are skipped.

compact_focus_enabled.title: Compact-focus hook
compact_focus_enabled.description: Records a typed /goal, a resumed handoff file and a step-away task file and posture in this session's focus file, and prints that file before each compaction so the summary keeps them. On by default. Your own value wins over docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml.

resume_context_enabled.title: Resume-context hook
resume_context_enabled.description: When a pasted resume prompt starts with its handoff directive, adds the resume procedure to that turn once per session: raise due reminders, reconcile recorded off-thread work, re-arm loops, cron tasks and monitors. On by default. Your own value wins over docs/conventions/session-flow.yaml.

away_orchestrate.title: Away orchestrator posture
away_orchestrate.description: When on, /session-flow:step-away runs every absence as an orchestrator: the main session delegates work and keeps only briefs, verdicts and state in its context, so it rides compaction through a long run. Off by default. Words in the launch line can turn it on or off for one run.
